card.name: Separators inside codes and lists
card.fires_on: Single separator characters (tab, space, comma, hyphen, slash) in the middle of structured strings such as format strings, device listings, NDC numbers, dose ratios and section-number lists.

modes.label: Format and device strings
modes.description: A tab, space or comma inside a technical format string or hardware listing.

modes.label: Numbers and section references
modes.description: A hyphen, slash or space between numbers in NDC codes, dose ratios, or lists of section numbers.

card.writes: It promotes quote-and-comma code fragments and suppresses unrelated foreign-language tokens, so it pushes toward code-like continuations.
card.plain: It fires on small separators like tabs, commas, hyphens and slashes inside codes, number lists and technical strings.
